cues.text: You and Yukari walk through Paulownia Mall's fountain square with your school bags. Yukari turns to you as she walks.
A small boy stands alone in the square, crying and rubbing his eyes with his arm. Yukari walks over to him, and you follow.
Yukari leads the boy across the square to the police box. Afterwards, the boy sits inside with a police officer while you and Yukari stand outside.
